wiki.title: John Wills (politician)
wiki.extract: John H. Wills (born February 18, 1966) is an American politician serving as speaker pro tempore as a member of the Iowa House of Representatives from the 10th district. Elected in November 2014, Wills assumed office on January 12, 2015.
